additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
A customer tried to charge several times on the charger 170002647 today 16 of December, thru different Apps and other two times thru Pos with Type 2 Plug, but he always had 0 recharges. We also performed a Reboot, but nothing changed.
Is it possible to check logs?:
- Between 2:31:32 p.m. and 2:31:36 p.m. (CU Time)
- Between 2:43:41 p.m. and 2:43:46 p.m. (CU Time)
- Between 2:49:22 p.m. and 2:49:25 p.m. (CU Time)

- Between 2:58:06 p.m. and 2:58:10 p.m. (CU Time)
Thank you in advance

additional_info.subject: 0468008 - ID0468008-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002647] CU logs check CRM:00472000488
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
On the specified sessions, the user is trying to start an AC charging session.
From our logs we see that we start the session and we start delivering power but immediately after the EV stop the session.
The charger send to OCPP backed the message SuspendedEV, this means the vehicle is not accepting power from the charger. This happens when the vehicle is fully charged, or when someone has configured the vehicle to stop charging at a certain threshold.
Since I didn't detect any fault from the charger, I will close this ticket.
With best regards,
